instruction: The "~/photographs/" directory in my file system has photo files organized in sub-directories for each vacation spot. Compress them and save them in "~/photographs/vacations/<vacation_spot>.zip" for each vacation spot, and then delete all vacation spot sub-directories. Here, <vacation_spot> is the name of the vacation spot as it appears in the sub-directory name.

login_res = apis.file_system.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password='Ia$)7$5')
print(login_res)
file_system_token = login_res.get('access_token')
print('token_set', bool(file_system_token))

photographs_dir = '~/photographs/'
listing = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=file_system_token, directory_path=photographs_dir, entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
print(listing)
print('count', len(listing))

vacations_parent = '~/photographs/vacations/'
spots = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=file_system_token, directory_path=vacations_parent, entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
print(spots)
print('count', len(spots))

import os, pathlib

vacations_parent = os.path.dirname(spots[0].rstrip('/'))  # /home/nicholas/photographs/vacations
print('vacations_parent', vacations_parent)

results = {}
for spot_dir in spots:
    spot_name = os.path.basename(spot_dir.rstrip('/'))
    zip_path = os.path.join(vacations_parent, f'{spot_name}.zip')
    print('\nProcessing spot:', spot_name)
    print('Directory:', spot_dir)
    print('Zip path:', zip_path)

    zip_exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=file_system_token, file_path=zip_path).get('exists')
    print('Zip exists?', zip_exists)

    compress_kwargs = {
        'directory_path': spot_dir,
        'access_token': file_system_token,
        'compressed_file_path': zip_path
    }
    if zip_exists:
        compress_kwargs['overwrite'] = True
    comp_res = apis.file_system.compress_directory(**compress_kwargs)
    print('Compress result:', comp_res)

    del_res = apis.file_system.delete_directory(directory_path=spot_dir, access_token=file_system_token)
    print('Delete result:', del_res)

    results[spot_name] = {'zip_path': zip_path, 'zip_existed_before': zip_exists, 'compressed': True, 'deleted': True}

print('\nDone. Spots processed:', list(results.keys()))

import os
vacations_parent = '/home/nicholas/photographs/vacations'
spots = ['athens','maui','stockholm','tokyo']
verification = {}

# Check zip existence
for spot in spots:
    zip_path = os.path.join(vacations_parent, f'{spot}.zip')
    zip_exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=file_system_token, file_path=zip_path).get('exists')
    spot_dir = os.path.join(vacations_parent, spot) + '/'  # may or may not exist with slash
    # directory_exists requires directory_path string; normalize without trailing slash
    spot_dir_norm = os.path.join(vacations_parent, spot)
    dir_exists = apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=file_system_token, directory_path=spot_dir_norm).get('exists')
    verification[spot] = {'zip_path': zip_path, 'zip_exists': zip_exists, 'dir_exists': dir_exists}

# Check remaining vacation spot directories count
remaining_dirs = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=file_system_token, directory_path=vacations_parent, entry_type='directories', recursive=False)

print('verification', verification)
print('remaining_dirs', remaining_dirs)
print('remaining_count', len(remaining_dirs))
